title: Where do the 25 minutes go?
hook: A 25-minute task, a fixed call at 20, and an hour free. Where does it go?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that a movable task fits only in one continuous free stretch before or after a fixed appointment, not across it

misconception: A task that fits in the day's free time in total will fit around a fixed call.
objective: Place flexible work around a fixed calendar interval.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A 25-minute task, a fixed call at 20, and an hour free. Where does it go? A 25-minute task and a call at 20 to 30. Free until 60. Where does it fit? Options: From 0, across the call / From 30 / Anywhere. Correct option: From 30. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

recall.question: A fixed call runs 11:00–11:30. A movable 25-minute task must not overlap it and must be done before the call. What is its latest start?
recall.why: The call cannot move, so the task must end by 11:00: 11:00 − 25 minutes = 10:35.
